Millbrook grew from 34,590 to 37,203, a factor of 37,203 ÷ 34,590. Applying the same percentage growth to 2025 gives:

37,203 × (37,203 ÷ 34,590) ≈ 40,012

This exceeds 40,000 residents.

ANSWER: yes | 40012

Millbrook’s growth from 2020 to 2025 was:

\[
\frac{37,203-34,590}{34,590} \approx 7.5548\%
\]

Applying the same percentage growth to its 2025 population:

\[
37,203 \times 1.075548 \approx 40,014
\]

This exceeds 40,000 residents.

ANSWER: yes | 40014
